scope.evidence_boundary: Only committed contracts, protocols, and sanitized aggregate result references were considered. No archive, private/hidden evidence, payload, or new experiment execution was accessed.
scope.claim: This inventory identifies candidate surfaces for later review; it does not establish a Claim IR schema, source role, train admission, lineage credit, quota credit, or L2 completion.

recommendation_basis: The contract explicitly scopes the public planner family.
Runtime visibility is restricted to public config/state/action fields.
Labels, recoverable/hidden/required claim identifiers, oracle state, mask membership, and realized outcomes are forbidden or not visible.
The independent statistical unit is case_or_attack_chain; repeated mask/intensity/seed conditions are not independent cases.
